notesEn: New designed opening: a calm branded intro animation now plays in full on every app launch - logo grows gently, name and line appear softly, then your content. It can no longer be cut short.
notesHi: Naya designed opening: ab har app launch par shant branded intro animation poora chalega - logo aaram se badhta hai, naam aur line naram se aati hai, phir content. Ab ye beech me kat nahi sakta.
